title: AnchorMTS: Multi-View Signal Representation and Forecast-Anchored Fusion for Long-Term Time-Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2611.13794v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-term time-series forecasters typically optimize a single numerical representation, even though the same history exposes complementary geometry, recurrence, and semantic structure. We propose AnchorMTS, which derives self-aligned visual and textual views from each observed window and uses them only to refine a complete numerical forecast. A trainable evidence path produces a candidate forecast, while a parameter-free output projection enforces an exact per-variable bound on its displacement from the numerical anchor. Across six benchmarks and four horizons, AnchorMTS achieves the best macro MSE/MAE (0.336/0.367) among seven supervised baselines and wins 18 of 24 MSE settings against the cellwise baseline envelope; removing the auxiliary path raises macro MSE to 0.340. The projection leaves 95.8% of candidate refinements unchanged while yielding zero bound violations, showing that complementary multi-view evidence can improve forecast

translated_title: AnchorMTS：用于长期时间序列预测的多视图信号表示与预测锚定融合
translated_abstract: 长期时间序列预测模型通常只优化单一的数值表示，尽管同一段历史数据中蕴含着互补的几何、循环和语义结构。我们提出AnchorMTS，该方法从每个观测窗口中提取自对齐的视觉视图和文本视图，并仅用它们来完善一个完整的数值预测。一个可训练的证据路径产生候选预测，同时一个无参数的输出投影对其相对数值锚点的位移施加精确的逐变量约束。在六个基准数据集和四种预测跨度的实验中，AnchorMTS在七个监督基线模型中取得了最佳的宏观MSE/MAE（0.336/0.367），并在24个MSE设置中的18个上优于逐单元基线包络；移除辅助路径会使宏观MSE上升至0.340。该投影使95.8%的候选修正保持不变，同时实现零边界违规，表明互补的多视图证据能够提升预测性能。
tldr: AnchorMTS通过从时间序列中提取视觉和文本等多视图表示来修正数值预测，在多个基准数据集上取得了最先进的长期预测性能。
en_tdlr: AnchorMTS refines numerical forecasts with self-aligned visual and textual views derived from the same time-series history, achieving state-of-the-art long-term forecasting performance across multiple benchmarks.
